# Classic Options UI resources

These text resources are installed alongside the user's Classic 1.99 game data.
They are **not GPL source**. Copyright 2026 Bohemia Interactive a.s.; distributed
under the APL-SA terms in [APL-SA_NOTICE.txt](APL-SA_NOTICE.txt).

The five `options*.hpp` files come from the official Arma: Cold War Assault
Remastered Demo's `BIN` directory (Steam app 4819000), as locally available on
2026-09-19. Only line endings were normalized. `STRINGTABLE_OPTIONS.utf8.csv`
is the existing UD Classic adaptation: the Options translations extracted from
the Demo's stringtable, with the temporary zoom action label added. Its changes
remain under APL-SA. The installer also copies the license notice into `BIN`.

No game executables, PBOs, models, textures or sounds are included. These headers
refer to models and sounds supplied by the user's game installation.
